blocks.text: {{companyName}} operates as an online networking and discovery platform connecting content creators (**“Creators”**) with businesses and brands (**“Brands”**) seeking to collaborate on user-generated content (UGC), influencer, or promotional campaigns.

{{companyName}} does not act as an agent, employer, or contracting party for either side. All relationships, negotiations, and financial agreements are conducted directly between the Creator and the Brand.
To use the Platform, you must:

items: Be at least 18 years old;
Have full legal capacity to enter into binding agreements; and
Provide accurate, truthful, and complete information when registering.

blocks.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate access to any user who provides false or misleading information.
3.1 Creator Accounts
Creators registering on the Platform agree to submit certain personal information such as name, photo, age, niche, social media links, portfolio, and a short biography.
By submitting this data, you authorize {{companyName}} to:

items: Display your profile information within the private Creator Catalog accessible only to verified and paying Brand users;
Use your contact information (e-mail) to communicate about new campaigns, opportunities, and platform updates;
Contact you for verification or quality-control purposes.

blocks.text: 3.2 Brand Accounts
Brands may access Creator profiles through paid subscription packages or authorized access. Brands agree:

items: To use Creator data solely for legitimate collaboration purposes;
Not to harvest, copy, resell, or publicly distribute Creator information;
To comply with all applicable data-protection and advertising laws.
